sources.title: chomeed/mimicgen_threading_d0_224x224_dinowm_dinov2base - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Raw feature MSE is not comparable across encoders — each model predicts its own encoder's feature space, with its own scale. dinov2-base's copy-the-current-frame baseline is 0.9749 against dinov2-small's 1.5526, so base looks 35% "better" on raw loss while actually being worse.

sources.title: chomeed/mimicgen_threading_d0_224x224_dinowm_heavy · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: A larger-predictor variant of chomeed/mimicgen_threading_d0_224x224_dinowm. Same task, same data, same frozen facebook/dinov2-small encoder, same 8-action / 8-frame jump — the predictor is scaled from 13.2M → 35.6M and trained with warmup + cosine decay and gradient clipping. This is the step-55,000 checkpoint, not the end of the run.
